page: Vultr voc-s-16c-128gb-2560s-amd is an Optimized Cloud Compute server powered by an AMD EPYC processor with x86_64 architecture. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 8 physical cores with 2 threads per core, operating at a clock speed of 2.0 GHz. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM, providing a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core. Local storage is bundled and consists of 2560 GB of NVMe SSD storage. No GPU is included in this configuration.

Benchmark results show strong performance in specific memory operations and single-core CPU tasks. The stress-ng single-core CPU performance is rated as strong, while multi-core performance falls in the average range. Memory bandwidth tests reveal top-tier performance for large block write operations and strong performance for large block read-only operations. Passmark memory testing also registers in the strong category. Other metrics, including Geekbench multi-core scores, Redis SET operations, and static web serving throughput, consistently perform in the average tier.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the server offers a high-density memory-to-vCPU ratio paired with a substantial local NVMe SSD, making it a viable option for memory-intensive workloads without requiring specialized GPU hardware. The combination of dedicated AMD EPYC cores, strong memory write speeds, and 2560 GB of NVMe storage makes this instance well-suited for database hosting, memory-cached applications, large-scale data processing, and general-purpose enterprise workloads.
